summary: The diff implements most of the requested informational single-page structure with centralized editable content, a Documents section with empty-state, and a visible disclaimer in the footer. However, the required generated static images are only referenced (not shown as added), and there are unrequested additions such as Internet Identity/react-query actor scaffolding, an empty backend canister, and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking.

missing_requirements.requirement: Render any generated images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the site (hero illustration and favicon).
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references the hero image and favicon paths, but the diff summary does not show the required image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity + React Query actor/auth scaffolding added (useInternetIdentity/useActor), despite the site being specified as informational and not requiring authentication.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly says Internet Identity is supported but not required; no requirement asks for identity context, actor creation, or query invalidation logic.
evidence: frontend/src/main.tsx (wraps app in InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider)

hallucinated_features.reason: No requirements request any backend behavior; the Documents section should be static with no backend required.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes a 'Built with caffeine.ai' outbound link with UTM tracking parameters.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request vendor attribution links or analytics/tracking parameters in the UI.
